criteria.requirement: Repair dynamic retry configuration and jitter adaptation so TypeError raised inside a valid callable propagates as the same exception and is never swallowed or retried with another signature. Use binding/introspection to preserve wait-generator runtime value callbacks requiring an argument, legal dynamic max_tries/max_time and truly nullary deprecated jitter with its warning. Resolve configuration before target execution and preserve synchronous/asynchronous behavior. Do not catch all TypeError around user execution as a signature probe.
